title: FleetRunResult
description: State of a bulk fleet remediation run, produced and updated by bin/fleet-retrofit.sh across its three phases. `--plan` emits phase=plan with each repo classified (clean / drifted / ungoverned / error) and a suggested action; the skill layer then walks the repos, driving the EXISTING single-repo machinery (retrofit → plan-bootstrap → preview → confirm → bootstrap) per repo, recording each outcome with `--record` (phase=in-progress); `--finalize` stamps phase=final, converts unreached pending rows to skipped, and fills the summary counts. The script layer never mutates a repo — every mutation flows through the per-repo preview-and-confirm contract.

bootstrap_missing.description: Whether ungoverned repos were planned for bootstrap (--bootstrap-missing) or marked skipped.

classification.description: clean/drifted from a report-only drift computation; ungoverned = no boot record and no resolvable profile; error = dead path or the drift computation failed.

action.description: What actually happened. pending until recorded; declined = the user said no at the per-repo confirm; skipped = ungoverned without --bootstrap-missing, or never reached before finalize.
